y-m-06-05.title: Mafi ƙarancin adadin ɗalibai nawa ne mai nasara zai iya samu?
y-m-06-05.topic: Karanta bayanai: alaƙar abin da aka fi zaɓa da jimillar mutane
y-m-06-05.goal: Gwada maganar ‘mai nasara yana da aƙalla rabin jimilla’ ta ƙirƙirar misalai masu saɓani, ka nemo mafi ƙarancin ƙuri'u da mai nasara dole ya samu domin a sami mai nasara guda ɗaya kawai.
y-m-06-05.material:
Ɗalibai 20 kowannensu ya zaɓi abincin makaranta guda ɗaya daga tteokbokki, gimbap, ramyeon, da dumplings. Kowa ya zaɓi guda ɗaya kawai. Idan abinci guda ɗaya ne kaɗai aka fi zaɓa, muna kiran shi ‘mai nasara’. Idan adadin mafi yawa ya yi daidai, muna cewa babu mai nasara.
Jaei ya ce, “Dole ne aƙalla ɗalibai 10 su zaɓi abincin da ya yi nasara. Rabin 20 kenan.”
y-m-06-05.thinking.0: Gwada magana ta gama-gari da misali mai saɓani
y-m-06-05.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri tebur da dama masu cika sharuɗɗa
y-m-06-05.thinking.2: Nemo mafi ƙarancin yanayi ka faɗi iyakar
y-m-06-05.prereq.0: Raba lambobi har zuwa 20 zuwa sassa da dama
y-m-06-05.s.s1.prompt: Wace hanya ce ta dace don gano ko maganar Jaei daidai ce koyaushe?
y-m-06-05.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta da kalmomi yadda tebur ɗin da ya saɓa wa maganar Jaei gaba ɗaya zai kasance.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.hint.1: Yanke lambar ƙuri'un mai nasara guda ɗaya da ya dace a fara gwadawa.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.o.a: Ƙirƙiri wani tebur inda mai nasara yake da ɗalibai 10.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.r.a: Yanayin 10 ɗin ya riga ya dace da maganar. Domin gano ko akwai tebur da ya saɓa mata, dole ne ka nemi wani yanayi dabam.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.o.b: Ƙirƙiri tebur inda duk abincin huɗun yake da adadi iri ɗaya.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.r.b: Idan dukkansu iri ɗaya ne, babu mai nasara, don haka ba za ka iya gwada maganar ba.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.o.c: Ka ɗauka Jaei daidai ne, ka nemi dalilin da ya sa.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.r.c: Idan ka fara da tunanin cewa magana daidai ce ka nemi dalilai kawai, kana iya rasa yanayin da maganar ta karye.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.o.d: Ƙirƙiri tebur inda mai nasara yake da ɗalibai ƙasa da 10.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.r.d: Wannan tunani yana ƙoƙarin ƙirƙirar misali da ya saɓa wa maganar da kanka.
y-m-06-05.s.s1.explain: Kalmar ‘dole’ tana karyewa idan za ka iya ƙirƙirar ko tebur guda ɗaya da ya saɓa. Ka gwada nemo tebur mai mai nasara guda ɗaya wanda yake da ƙasa da ɗalibai 10.
y-m-06-05.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri tebur biyu daban-daban da ke nuna cewa maganar Jaei ba daidai ba ce. Tteokbokki dole ne ya zama mai nasara (ya fi kowane abinci), ɗaliban tteokbokki su zama 9 ko ƙasa da haka, kuma jimillar abinci huɗun ɗalibai 20 ce.
y-m-06-05.s.s2.hint.0: Yanke adadin tteokbokki, sannan ka rarraba ɗaliban da suka rage tsakanin sauran abinci uku.
y-m-06-05.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko sauran abinci uku duka sun fi tteokbokki kaɗan.
y-m-06-05.s.s2.ok.c1: Adadin ɗalibai cikakkun lambobi ne 0 ko fiye.
y-m-06-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Adadin ɗalibai dole ya zama cikakkun lambobi 0 ko fiye.
y-m-06-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Jimillar abinci huɗun dole ta zama ɗalibai 20.
y-m-06-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Tteokbokki ya fi sauran abinci duka yawa, saboda haka shi ne mai nasara.
y-m-06-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Tteokbokki dole ya fi gimbap, ramyeon, da dumplings kowanne yawa.
y-m-06-05.s.s2.ok.c4: Mai nasara yana da ɗalibai 9 ko ƙasa da haka, saboda haka ya saɓa wa maganar Jaei.
y-m-06-05.s.s2.fail.c4: Idan mai nasara yana da ɗalibai 10 ko fiye, yanayi ne da ya dace da maganar Jaei. Gwada ɗalibai 9 ko ƙasa da haka.
y-m-06-05.s.s2.explain: Misali, tteokbokki 6, gimbap 5, ramyeon 5, dumplings 4, jimillarsu ɗalibai 20 ce kuma tteokbokki ne ya yi nasara, amma yana da ƙasa da 10. Saboda haka maganar ‘dole mai nasara ya samu aƙalla 10’ ba daidai ba ce. Teburan da aka musanya wuraren gimbap, ramyeon, da dumplings ana ɗaukar su yanayi ɗaya ne.
y-m-06-05.s.s3.prompt: Idan ɗalibai 20 kowannensu ya zaɓi abinci guda ɗaya cikin huɗu kuma mai nasara guda ɗaya ne, mafi ƙarancin ɗalibai nawa ne suka zaɓi abincin da ya yi nasara?
y-m-06-05.s.s3.hint.0: Sanya mai nasara ya zama ɗalibai 5, ka rubuta adadin da sauran abinci ukun za su iya samu gabaɗaya idan kowanne yana ƙasa da 5.
y-m-06-05.s.s3.hint.1: Kwatanta wannan mafi yawa da ɗalibai 20.
y-m-06-05.s.s3.r.a: Idan ka raba ɗalibai 20 daidai tsakanin abinci huɗu, kowanne yana da 5. Amma idan dukkansu iri ɗaya ne, babu mai nasara guda ɗaya.
y-m-06-05.s.s3.r.b: Idan mai nasara yana da 5, sauran duka 4 ko ƙasa da haka ne, saboda haka bai isa ba. Zai yiwu daga ɗalibai 6.
y-m-06-05.s.s3.r.c: Gaskiya ne cewa akwai tebur mai 7, amma ka duba ko ƙaramin adadi ma zai yiwu.
y-m-06-05.s.s3.r.d: Ɗalibai 10 ita ce ƙimar da Jaei ya faɗa. Mun riga mun ƙirƙiri tebur mai ƙasa da haka.
y-m-06-05.s.s3.explain: Idan mai nasara yana da 5, sauran abinci ukun kowanne yana da 4 ko ƙasa da haka, don haka 5+4+4+4=17 bai kai 20 ba. Idan yana da 6, za a iya yin 6+5+5+4=20. Saboda haka mai nasara yana da aƙalla 6.

y-m-06-02.title: Shin tunaninmu yana canzawa duk lokacin da sakamakon bincike ya zo?
y-m-06-02.topic: Tattara bayanai: maganganun da ke canzawa bisa yawan mutanen da aka tambaya
y-m-06-02.goal: Kwatanta sakamakon tambayar wasu mutane da na tambayar mutane da yawa, ka fahimci yadda ƙarfin amincewa yake canzawa, ka nemo yanayin da amsar wanda ba a tambaya ba tukuna za ta iya sauya sakamakon.
y-m-06-02.material: Aji na 3 na aji na 2 yana da ɗalibai 24 gaba ɗaya. Suna son zaɓar abin ciye-ciye na yawon shakatawa daga jelly, biskit, da burodi; kowane mutum ya zaɓi guda ɗaya kawai. Sakamakon binciken yana zuwa a hankali. Yayin da kake karanta sakamakon da ya zo, sauya tunaninka game da abin da ya dace a zaɓa ko ka bar shi yadda yake.
y-m-06-02.thinking.0: Daidaita hukunci ko barinsa yadda yake bisa sabon bayani
y-m-06-02.thinking.1: Yi hankali kada a faɗaɗa sakamakon wasu mutane zuwa dukan rukuni
y-m-06-02.thinking.2: Nemo sharuɗɗan da sakamakon zai canza a ƙarƙashinsu
y-m-06-02.s.s1.prompt: Karanta bayanan bisa jerin isowarsu, a kowane lokaci ka zaɓi hukuncin da za ka iya yankewa yanzu.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kwatanta ko sakamakon da ya zo yanzu yana goyon bayan hukuncin baya ko ya saɓa masa.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ƙirga ko akwai mutanen da ba su amsa ba tukuna.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Da farko an tambayi ɗalibai 6. 4 sun zaɓi jelly, 1 biskit, 1 burodi. Ɗalibai 18 ba su amsa ba tukuna.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Da wannan sakamako, me ya kamata mu yi game da abin ciye-ciyen ajin ɗalibai 24?
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Jelly ya yi gaba, amma ɗalibai 18 sun rage, saboda haka da wuri ne a kafe cewa sakamakon ajin gaba ɗaya haka yake. Yin hasashe da kuma tambayar ƙarin mutane duk sun dace.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Mutane da yawa sun zaɓi jelly, don haka ajin gaba ɗaya ma jelly ne zai fi yawa.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wannan ya faɗaɗa sakamakon ɗalibai 6 kai tsaye zuwa ajin gaba ɗaya. Ba mu san zaɓin sauran 18 ba tukuna.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: An tambayi ɗalibai 6 kawai, saboda haka da wuri ne a zaɓi abin ciye-ciyen ajin gaba ɗaya.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan ya lura cewa har yanzu akwai mutane da yawa da ba mu sani ba.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Jelly kamar yana gaba, saboda haka ka yi hasashe na ɗan lokaci ka kuma tambayi ƙarin mutane.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wannan tunani ya yi amfani da sakamakon yanzu a matsayin tushen hasashe, ba tare da kafe shi ba, sannan ya yi ƙoƙarin samun ƙarin bayani.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Biskit da burodi guda 1 ne kawai, saboda haka a cire su daga zaɓi tun farko.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wannan ya soke ƙananan adadin a matsayin zaɓi, duk da cewa ba mu san abin da sauran za su zaɓa ba tukuna.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Yanzu an tambayi dukkan ɗalibai 20 da suka halarta (har da 6 na farko). 7 sun zaɓi jelly, 9 biskit, 4 burodi.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Zaɓi abin da za ka iya faɗa daga wannan sakamakon.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Sakamakon ɗalibai 6 na farko ya yi rauni idan aka kwatanta da 20. Cikin 20 za ka iya cewa biskit ne mafi yawa, burodi kuma mafi kaɗan. Bai isa a faɗi game da dukkan 24 ba tukuna.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Cikin ɗalibai 20 da aka tambaya, mutane da yawa sun zaɓi biskit.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wannan magana tana karanta sakamakon 20 yadda yake kawai.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: A cikin 6 na farko jelly ne ya fi yawa, don haka jelly ne mafi yawa.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wannan har yanzu yana amincewa da sakamakon 6 na farko. Kwatanta shi da sakamakon 20 da ya zo yanzu.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Cikin 20, mafi ƙarancin adadi sun zaɓi burodi.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wannan magana ta kwatanta lambobi ukun ta karanta su.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Mutane 9 sun zaɓi biskit, saboda haka a yanke cewa ajin 24 ma biskit ne zai fi yawa.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wannan ya faɗaɗa sakamakon 20 kai tsaye zuwa dukan 24. Har yanzu akwai waɗanda ba su zo ba.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Amma waɗannan 20 abokan da suka halarta ne. Ɗalibai 4 da ba su halarta ba a ranar ba su zaɓa ba tukuna. Ga sakamakon 20 cikin 24 kamar haka.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Me ya kamata mu yi domin zaɓar abin ciye-ciye?
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Ɗalibai 4 da ba su halarta ba za su iya sauya sakamakon. A mataki na gaba, gano da kanka yadda za su iya sauya shi. Tunanin 'a zaɓi biskit amma a ce yana iya canzawa' ya dace, kamar yadda 'a fara tambayar 4 ɗin' ma ya dace.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Sakamakon na iya canzawa bisa zaɓin ɗalibai 4 da ba su halarta ba, saboda haka a tambaye su ma. (4)
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wannan tunani yana la'akari da yiwuwar sauran mutane su sauya sakamakon.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Yanzu biskit ne ya fi yawa, saboda haka a zaɓe shi, amma a ce sakamakon na iya canzawa bisa zaɓin ɗalibai 4 da ba su halarta ba.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wannan ya yi amfani da sakamakon yanzu, ya kuma bayyana sharadin cewa ba a kammala hukunci ba.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: A yanke shawarar biskit bisa zato cewa ɗalibai 4 da ba su halarta ba sun zaɓi biskit ma.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ba mu san yadda abokan da ba su halarta ba za su zaɓa ba, amma wannan ya ɗauka za su yi daidai da sakamakon yanzu.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Ba za a iya amincewa da sakamakon 20 ba, don haka a sake gudanar da binciken tun daga farko.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wannan ya yar da duk sakamakon da aka riga aka tattara. Ka duba ko ya isa a binciki mutane 4 da ba mu sani ba kawai.
y-m-06-02.s.s1.reflect: Sakamakon 6 na farko, na 20 da suka halarta, da gaskiyar cewa 4 ba su amsa ba, duk sun sauya 'yawan abin da za mu iya faɗa'. Ba dole ne ka manne wa hukunci bayan ka yanke shi ba; kuma hanya ce mai kyau ka bayyana shi da sharadin da ya dace da sakamakon yanzu.
y-m-06-02.s.s2.prompt: A ce kowane cikin ɗalibai 4 da ba su halarta ba zai zaɓi jelly ko biskit kawai (babu wanda ya zaɓi burodi). Idan k daga cikinsu suka zaɓi jelly, (4-k) suka zaɓi biskit. Idan aka ƙara zaɓin waɗannan 4 ga sakamakon mutane 20 (jelly 7, biskit 9, burodi 4), nemo ƙimomin k biyu mabambanta da za su sa jelly ya yi daidai ko ya fi biskit, ka shigar da su.
y-m-06-02.s.s2.hint.0: Yanke wata ƙimar k, ka rubuta a layuka biyu yawan masu zaɓar jelly da biskit.
y-m-06-02.s.s2.hint.1: Canza k ɗaya bayan ɗaya daga 0 zuwa 4 ka kwatanta lambobin biyu.
y-m-06-02.s.s2.var.k: Adadin ɗalibai 4 da ba su halarta ba waɗanda suka zaɓi jelly
y-m-06-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Adadin mutane cikakkiyar lamba ce daga 0 zuwa 4.
y-m-06-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Akwai ɗalibai 4 da ba su halarta ba, saboda haka k dole ne ya zama ɗaya daga 0, 1, 2, 3, 4.
y-m-06-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Jelly ya zama daidai ko ya fi biskit.
y-m-06-02.s.s2.fail.c2: A wannan yanayin, jelly ya yi ƙasa da biskit. Ƙara k ga jelly 7, sannan (4-k) ga biskit 9, ka kwatanta.
y-m-06-02.s.s2.explain: Idan k ya zama 3, jelly 10 ne, biskit 10 ne, don haka sun yi daidai; idan k ya zama 4, jelly 11 ne, biskit 9. Idan k ya zama 2 ko ƙasa da haka, biskit zai ci gaba da gaba. Saboda haka idan aƙalla 3 cikin ɗalibai 4 da ba su halarta ba suka zaɓi jelly, sakamakon zai canza.

y-m-06-03.title: Shin hotuna uku da gaske mutane 3 ne?
y-m-06-03.topic: Jadawalin hoto: dalilin da ya sa ake buƙatar sanin yawan da hoto ɗaya yake wakilta
y-m-06-03.goal: Ka fahimci cewa domin faɗin adadin mutane daga jadawalin hoto, dole ne a san yawan da hoto ɗaya yake wakilta. Bayan an sami wannan bayani, yanke ƙimomin jadawalin hoto da suka cika sharuɗɗa.
y-m-06-03.material:
An nuna adadin ɗaliban da suka zo ɗakin karatu a kowace rana a jadawalin hoto. Amma layin ƙarƙashin jadawalin da ya ce 'da'ira ◯ ɗaya tana wakiltar ɗalibai nawa' an goge. Rabin hoto ◐ yana wakiltar rabin ◯. Ba a zana Laraba da Alhamis ba tukuna.
Litinin: ◯ ◯ ◯
Talata: ◯ ◯ ◐
Jeongwu ya ƙirga hotunan ya ce, 'Litinin ɗalibai 3 ne.'

Harin tana son raba maɓallai 8 zuwa rukuni biyu. An nuna launi, siffa, da yawan ramukan kowane maɓalli a jadawalin da ke ƙasa.

Maɓalli 4: rawaya / da'ira / ramuka 2
